- **C1-B (Self-Referential Spectral Collapse Detection)**: Self-referential spectral effective rank (computed on model-generated text) detects model collapse that holdout-side metrics (PPL, standard eff_rank) miss entirely within the first 1–3 generations of iterative synthetic training. - **C3-B (Collapse Mitigation)**: Same as C3.

|-----------|-----------------|------|
| Measurement surface | Holdout/reference data | **Self-generated text** |
